title: Quantum FPS
description: A simple performance modpack focused entirely on optimization. Improve FPS, reduce lag, speed up loading times, and enhance stability without altering vanilla Minecraft gameplay.
body:
**Overview**

This modpack is designed exclusively to improve Minecraft's performance.

**Features**

* Higher FPS
* Reduced lag and stuttering
* Faster loading times
* Improved overall stability

**What This Pack Does Not Include**

* No gameplay changes
* No new content
* No visual overhauls
* No altered mechanics

This is a pure optimization pack built for players who want the smoothest possible Minecraft experience while keeping the game completely vanilla.
